# K Laxman — AI/ML Engineer & Full Stack Developer

> Senior AI Engineer at Think360 AI (CAMS) and IIT Delhi graduate (M.Tech & B.Tech, Computer Science). Builds production Generative AI systems end to end: LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, and full-stack products with React, Python and cloud infrastructure.

## Projects (26)

- [CAMS Lens — SEBI-Grounded Compliance Intelligence Platform](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/cams-lens): Productionized an enterprise-grade GenAI compliance platform leveraging RAG over 80,000+ SEBI and financial regulatory documents. Achieved 95% retrieval precision with sub-7-second response latency, delivering audit-ready, citation-backed… Tech: RAG, Google Cloud, Vertex AI, Cloud Run, AlloyDB, BigQuery, Python, AI/ML.
- [CAMSCode — Enterprise AI Coding Assistant](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/camscode): Built an internal, secure, private alternative to GitHub Copilot deployed entirely within CAMS infrastructure. Autonomously converts PRDs and HLDs into production-ready full-stack applications using 80+ custom tools and MCP servers —… Tech: AI/ML, Agentic AI, MCP Servers, Ollama, RAG, Google Cloud, Vertex AI, Cloud Run.
- [Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) - Multi-Agent System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/intelligent-document-processing): Enterprise-level Multi-Agent Orchestration Framework using LangGraph and Gemini 2.5 Flash to automate data extraction from complex Mutual Fund forms. Features self-correcting agents and confidence-based automation. Tech: LangGraph, Gemini 2.5, Vertex AI, Python, Pydantic, Docker.
- [OpsPilot — Agentic Request Triage & Remediation System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/opspilot): Developed an end-to-end Agentic AI platform that automates customer support operations by understanding incoming emails, planning intelligent remediation workflows, validating decisions through policy guardrails, and providing transparent… Tech: Gemini 2.5, Python, Streamlit, SQLite, Pandas, Altair.
- [NexGenGaming - E-Commerce Platform](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/nexgengaming-ecommerce): Full-stack gaming e-commerce with real-time inventory, order tracking, and payment integration. Tech: React, Node.js, MongoDB, Express, Firebase, TailwindCSS, Vercel.
- [RoomFlow - AI Booking System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/roomflow-ai-booking): AI-assisted workspace booking platform with dynamic pricing, real-time conflict prevention, and admin analytics. Tech: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Vite, PostgreSQL, TailwindCSS.
- [SEBI Debarred PAN Extraction](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/sebi-debarred-pan-extraction): Cloud-native backend monitoring SEBI regulatory orders, extracting debarred PAN details using AI-powered document parsing. Tech: Python, Google Cloud, Vertex AI, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Docker.
- [AI-Powered Email Automation](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/ai-email-automation): Intelligent microservice classifying financial emails with 95% accuracy. Extracts PAN, ARN codes using LLM zero-shot learning. Tech: Python, Google Cloud, FastAPI, LLM, vLLM, Docker, REST API.
- [IPO Monitoring System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/ipo-monitoring-system): Real-time IPO Grey Market Premium monitoring with automated notifications for investment decisions. Tech: Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Web Scraping.
- [Autonomous Multi-Agent Banking](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/autonomous-multi-agent-banking): Advanced agentic workflow with 7 specialized AI agents using CrewAI and Gemini 2.5 for banking operations. Tech: CrewAI, LangChain, Dialogflow CX, Vertex AI, Python, Google Cloud.
- [Dialogflow CX Virtual Agent — Financial Services Chatbot & Voicebot (GCP / CCAI)](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/dialogflow-cx-virtual-agent): Built and launched a production-style Dialogflow CX virtual agent for banking/financial services on GCP, covering 6+ customer intents (account statements, balance, transaction history, fund transfer, bill payment, contact updates)… Tech: Dialogflow CX, CCAI Telephony, Vertex AI, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Python, IaC.
- [RSS Document Downloader](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/rss-document-downloader): Automated document downloading from RSS feeds for real-time regulatory content acquisition. Tech: Python, RSS, PDF Processing, Streamlit.
- [MSG to PDF Converter](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/msg-to-pdf-converter): Batch converter for Outlook .MSG files to PDF. Processed 20,000+ financial emails with attachments. Tech: Python, Outlook, WeasyPrint, Streamlit.
- [PDF Footnotes Processor](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/pdf-footnotes-processor): Automated footnotes and reference mapping for academic documents with Excel export. Tech: OpenCV, OCR, PDF Processing, Streamlit.
- [OCR Field Extraction](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/ocr-field-extraction): Automated extraction of PAN, Folio numbers from scanned documents using DocTR and custom post-processing. Tech: OpenCV, DocTR, Python, Streamlit.
- [Stock Exchange Platform](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/stock-exchange-platform): Full-stack stock trading platform with Spring Boot backend, real-time prices, and portfolio management. Tech: Spring Boot, Java, REST API, Database.
- [Driver Drowsiness Detection](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/driver-drowsiness-detection): Real-time embedded system for driver safety using Raspberry Pi with OpenCV and dlib. Tech: OpenCV, dlib, Embedded C, Raspberry Pi.
- [RAVI - Visual Assistant](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/ravi-visual-assistant): AI-powered Reading Assistant for Visually Impaired using computer vision and automated image descriptions. Tech: Azure, JavaScript, Python, Docker.
- [Table Recognition System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/table-recognition-system): Deep learning system for borderless table detection and recognition in PDF documents. Tech: Deep Learning, Python, MTL-Tabnet, PyTorch.
- [RAVI - Accessible STEM Education](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/ravi-accessible-stem-education): AI-powered accessibility tool for STEM documents enabling visually impaired students to access scientific content. Tech: Python, Flask, HTML, Machine Learning, Computer Vision.
- [SkyLine Airlines - DBMS System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/skyline-airlines-dbms): Airline reservation system with Flask and PostgreSQL featuring advanced SQL queries and booking management. Tech: Flask, PostgreSQL, HTML/CSS, SQL.
- [BitTorrent File Transfer](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/bittorrent-file-transfer): Implementation of BitTorrent P2P protocol with parallel TCP connections for distributed file sharing. Tech: Python, Networking, TCP/IP, P2P.
- [AmudalaKunta - Payment Gateway](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/amudalakunta-payment-gateway): Live web application with integrated payment gateway and admin dashboard for village development fund. Tech: HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Payment Gateway, Dashboard.
- [AI Pacman - Multi-Agent Search](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/ai-pacman-multi-agent-search): Advanced AI for Pacman featuring DFS, BFS, A*, and minimax with alpha-beta pruning. Tech: Python, AI/ML, Algorithms, Game AI.
- [VM Snapshot System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/vm-snapshot-system): KVM-based VM snapshot service built with Rust. Features live snapshotting, incremental backups, and a web interface for VM state management. Tech: Rust, Virtualization, HTML, CSS.
- [Smart Lift Controller System](https://laxman824.github.io/projects/smart-lift-controller): Intelligent elevator control system in Verilog with optimized scheduling for multi-floor buildings. Tech: Verilog, Logic Design, Simulation, Algorithms.
